interventions.agent: miR-21 conditional knockout in sensory neurons (miR-21-cKO)

combinations.magnitude: SB431542 restored allodynia in cKO mice (2, 4 and 24 h) but not in WT mice
combinations.evidence_quote: Additionally, we observed that single intrathecal administration of SB431542 restored allodynia in miR-21–cKO but not WT mice at 2, 4, and 24 hours after

combinations.magnitude: antagomir-21-induced SMAD4 upregulation blocked by SB431542
combinations.evidence_quote: In addition, TGF-βR2 immunostaining was higher in antagomir-21– than scramble-transfected BMDMs (Figure 3B), along with more SMAD2/3 phosphorylation, and a significant upregulation of SMAD4 that was blocked by the presence of SB431542, a TGF-βR1 inhibitor (Figure 3, C and D).
